request.text: A Python web server started from an elevated shell on WORKSTATION5 is serving files after the firewall was opened for python.exe. Stop process 10220 (python.exe) on WORKSTATION5.

package.rationale: wardog's elevated PowerShell (PID 9320) opened and started netsh, and the firewall then stored a rule allowing all inbound traffic to python.exe; the same shell opened and started python -m http.server 8000 (PID 10220). The host now serves its files to the network; stop PID 10220.
